projects.name: Clinic & Medical Center SaaS Platform
bullets: Architected a multi-tenant SaaS clinic management backend using Spring Boot 3 and Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) across modular Maven layers (domain, application, infrastructure, boot).

Secured with Spring Security, JWT with immediate session revocation for suspended staff/tenants, hierarchical password resets, per-clinic patient blocking, and Docker/Nginx deployment.

projects.name: NovaCart — Enterprise E-Commerce Platform
bullets: Engineered a full-stack e-commerce platform using Spring Boot 4 (Java 17) and React 18 (TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) featuring bilingual AR (RTL) / EN (LTR) localization, balanced Light/Dark themes, and indicative multi-currency display.

Built advanced commerce workflows including SKU-level Product Variants, Promo Codes, Verified-Buyer Reviews, real-time STOMP WebSocket order tracking and admin alerts, and an immutable financial Audit Log.

Ensured transactional concurrency and stock integrity via Pessimistic/Optimistic Locking and Idempotency-Key deduplication, integrating Stripe Webhooks, Redis caching, RabbitMQ, Cloudinary, 27 automated unit/integration tests, and Docker/Nginx deployment.
